items: Weights (40/20/20/10/10), camp thresholds (±20), alert thresholds (15 / 25 points) and the 30-day half-life are proposed model parameters and are not validated (nicht validiert / not validated).

Every scored quote used on the public site is verbatim from an official Board or Reserve Bank page or PDF stored in this package. Licensed-press wording (including the Phase 1 Schmid 10.11 pointer) is not in site_data.

Interviews without an official transcript are unconfirmed and are not scored. That includes the 14.10 Daly Hoover appearance (official coverage page, no transcript), the 8.10 Musalem moderated Q&A (official event page is a short third-person summary, not a transcript), and an 18.11 Waller appearance for which no Board transcript was found.

Speeches without monetary-policy path or stance content are excluded from the public events table (including Musalem 6.10 community-banking remarks, 14.10 Open Vault blog, 6.11 decentralised-by-design; supervisory, payments and ceremonial Board and Reserve Bank remarks).

The official 29.09 Musalem 'How and Why' prepared-remarks body is incomplete in this package (Firecrawl result truncated after curl to stlouisfed.org timed out). Official key takeaways were retrieved in full and are the public quote. Error E20261120-dc2e is left open for this residual gap.

Phase 1 labelled Logan's 30.10 Davidson remarks as partial; the official text contains the same counted path as 10.11 and is scored in Phase 2. Primary-source dates are used throughout. Pre-screen date deviations remain: Williams path language is official on 29.09, not 13.10; the 10.11 Schmid pre-screen wording was not found on the official 15.11 transcript; the 14.10 Daly pre-screen wording was not verified on a primary transcript.

Missing dimensions are coded 'not observed', never 0. The allowed dimension codes are {-2,-1,+1,+2} or not_observed. An explicitly balanced or two-sided statement (Jefferson 19.11; parts of Barkin 9.11) cannot be coded 0 and is recorded as not observed, with the effect that coverage is not credited.

Event scores are computed from observed dimensions only, with weights renormalised over those dimensions and then scaled by 1/2 to the -100..+100 range. A single observed dimension therefore renormalises to ±50 or ±100. Coverage and confidence are published with the score; a high score with low coverage is not a high-confidence reading.

Where Pass A and Pass B disagree on any observed dimension, on sign, or on coverage by 20 percentage points or more, the event has no published final score (no averaging). Current stance uses agreed events only. Pass-specific stances are shown and are not averaged. Camp changes and counter-lean alerts require analyst sign-off; none are issued, because structural lean is 'insufficient history' in this 90-day sample.

Structural lean is not computed: the spec requires 12–18 months of evidence across different data regimes, which were not fetched in Phase 2. Camps printed on current stance are not structural classifications.

2026 voter status is taken from the official FOMC membership page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc.htm, last update 18 November 2026). Among the ten names, voters are Logan, Waller, Hammack, Bowman, Williams and Jefferson. Musalem and Schmid are not 2026 voters. Daly and Barkin are listed as 2026 alternate members.

Relative shift is a diagnostic (own change minus the median change of peers with a defined agreed change), not a causal estimate. Several people have no agreed pre-event baseline, so no change and no relative shift.
Panel A bubble size is the number of official, policy-relevant, verbatim-text evidence items in the 90-day window, not a market-influence weight.
No FRED or other API key, and no licensed dataset, is in this package. Firecrawl was used only for targeted official St. Louis Fed pages and PDFs after curl timed out.

A successful run of the scoring script proves that the arithmetic identities were executed, not that the dimension codes are financially or institutionally 'correct'. Dimension codes are analyst-style AI judgments from the stored official text, awaiting the later validation workstream in the build plan.
